name: THE CAMPUS
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: The map's campus is the university east of the Strip (engine/bohemia_overmap.js: 'big campus: housing, halls, Thomas & Mack'), four cells by three.

A university lecture hall seats hundreds in fixed rows with fold-down tablet arms, the rows stepped up toward the back, aisles between the banks; at the front the demonstration bench and the lectern under the screens, at the back the projection booth.

A teaching lab is island benches with sinks and gas taps, fume hoods along the walls (glass sashes in steel cabinets taller than a man), gas cylinders chained in racks, a corridor of lockers and vending machines between the labs; on house tiles a fume hood hides a man and a bench is cover.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (campus_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The campus is twelve cells of quads, lots, housing and halls: about one fight in three there is fought inside a lecture hall or the science labs, by the cell's own dice; the rest outside among its buildings.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The building's wall, and the projection booth's: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The hall's floor, an aisle or a corridor: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

seats.effect: A row of fixed seats with their tablet arms, a step up from the row in front: low cover, and slow going over them (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
seats.say: A row of seats: slow going, low cover.

demobench.effect: The demonstration bench at the front, a long counter of stone and steel: cover.

carts.effect: A cart (the projector's, the lab's), tipped: low cover.

bags.effect: Backpacks and coats left in a heap the day the classes stopped: low cover.

hoods.effect: A fume hood, a steel cabinet taller than a man with its glass sash down: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

shelves.effect: The stockroom's shelving, to the ceiling: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

benches.effect: An island lab bench, black stone on steel cupboards, its sink and its gas taps dry: cover.

gas.effect: Gas cylinders chained in their rack, empty: low cover.

vending.effect: A vending machine pulled over on its face, long since emptied: cover.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a waste bin. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The doors, open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in campus_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the lecture hall's rows step up a seat at a time (slow going), never a storey.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the hall's acoustic tiles, the dead projectors on their mounts, the labs' ducts, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
